style: Realistic editorial photograph, soft warm natural light, no people, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark.

images.prompt: A real European shopping street seen at a slight angle from across the road, four generous independent shops with wide plate glass windows and normal proportions: a clothing boutique with linen garments, a bookshop with stacked books, a grocer with wooden crates of vegetables and bread on the pavement, a plant shop with terracotta pots outside. Stone facades, wooden shopfronts painted in muted colors, cloth awnings, wide pavement, long soft shadows.
A linen shirt and trousers folded on a whitewashed step by the sea
Matte black headphones and a slim laptop on a dark oak desk under a single lamp
A wooden crate of ripe tomatoes, basil and a loaf of bread on a market table
A stack of clothbound books beside a reading lamp and a cup of tea
A thin gold chain and a pearl ring on a dark velvet tray in soft light
A frosted glass serum bottle and a ceramic dish with a sprig of eucalyptus on marble
A linen sofa corner with a wool throw and a ceramic vase of dried grass
Running shoes and a water bottle on a wet running track at dawn
A wooden stacking toy and a felt rabbit on a pale pink blanket
Terracotta pots with herbs on a sunlit potting bench with a trowel
